scope: Explicit source-audited bounded selection, not the complete perf-lab test suite
policy: files + uiFiles are offline-unit: no app/browser/build/sensor/network/paid execution. Disposable fixtures, format libraries, jsdom/VM, fake CDP/events/proc and source-only Node CLI subprocesses are allowed. readOnlyGitFiles is a separate source-inspection addition, never Git commits. pythonFiles uses injected gate operations only. offlineLocalFiles is separately authorized fake loopback HTTP only, never outside connections. No broad-glob execution; every addition requires source-boundary review.
